title: Pre-Analysis — Case Drain Filtration and Depressurisation Solenoid on the Green System Pump
abstract: Original pre-analysis for the full-flow case drain filter and redesigned depressurisation solenoid on the green system engine driven pump, closed with conditions on the contaminated-circuit population and the gear bay work.

sections.objective: Establish what the full-flow case drain filter and the redesigned depressurisation solenoid disturb on the green system, following the pump failure cluster that contaminated the whole circuit on eight aircraft. The work order had to determine whether the affected circuits can be returned to service without further work, identify the maintenance and troubleshooting content built around the unfiltered case drain, and check what else is installed in the main gear bay that the change touches.
sections.findings_summary: Four items came out and two of them shape the retrofit. The installation task assumes an unfiltered case drain return and has no filter servicing content at all, so a modified pump would be installed with a maintenance item nobody is told about. The reservoir low level procedure is built around the same assumption; it treats a rising case drain flow as a pump condition rather than as a filter approaching bypass, and after the change that reading is wrong. The two remaining items are bay items rather than system items: the gear lock link rework and its bulletin work in the same main gear bay and both require the green system depressurised, which is exactly the function the new solenoid changes. Neither shares a word of vocabulary with the pump change; both were found only through the bay zone.
sections.next_steps: Add filter servicing content to the installation task and give the filter a bypass indication threshold before the retrofit bulletin is issued. Revise the reservoir low level procedure to read case drain flow against the filter condition. Agree a depressurisation sequence with the landing gear office that is valid on both pump standards, and state it once rather than in each document. Confirm the eight contaminated circuits are flushed to the new filter standard before the pump is fitted.

expected_findings.rationale: The task assumes an unfiltered case drain return and contains no filter servicing content. A modified pump would enter service carrying a maintenance item that no document tells the operator about, which is not acceptable at bulletin issue.
expected_findings.resolution: Add filter servicing and a bypass indication threshold before the retrofit bulletin is issued.

evidence.similarity_note: Entity linked on the pump and its FIN position and returned again by similarity on the reservoir level symptom.

expected_findings.rationale: The procedure reads a rising case drain flow as a pump condition. With a full-flow filter installed the same reading means the filter is approaching bypass, so the procedure would condemn a serviceable pump.
expected_findings.resolution: Revise the flow interpretation against the filter condition.

expected_findings.rationale: The lock link and downlock sensing rework is embodied in the same main gear bay and requires the green system depressurised. The new solenoid changes how depressurisation is achieved and how it is confirmed, and neither document mentions the other.
expected_findings.resolution: Agree one depressurisation sequence valid on both pump standards.

expected_findings.rationale: The retrofit vehicle for the gear bay work quotes a depressurisation step by reference to the current solenoid behaviour. Operators embodying both bulletins in one visit would follow two different sequences for the same system state.
expected_findings.resolution: State the sequence once and reference it from both bulletins.

expected_non_findings.reason: Shares the main gear bay zone and is returned by every bay-driven search. It carries downlock sensing wiring and bay ground points; the pump has no electrical interface on that sheet and the solenoid is fed from a different harness entirely.

type_data.conclusion: The pump change is sound. Two manual revisions are required before bulletin issue and one depressurisation sequence must be agreed with the landing gear office.
